cards.name: hero
cards.title: Are likes public on Bluesky? **Yes, always**
cards.sub: Anyone can see who liked a post, and there’s no setting to hide your likes. Bookmarks stay private.

cards.name: visibility
cards.title: Hidden in the app, **public on the network**

right.label: Can’t see it
items: Other people, on your Likes tab
The author, for posts you only saved

cards.name: steps
cards.title: See who liked a post in **3 steps**

steps.title: Open the post
steps.text: Tap it in the feed to open it on its own.

steps.title: Tap the like count
steps.text: The number, not the heart icon.

steps.title: Scroll the list
steps.text: Every account that liked it, newest first.

good.label: Safe
items: Tools that read public data, no login

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Treat every Bluesky like as public. **Use bookmarks for anything you want to keep to yourself.**
cards.by: There’s no setting to hide likes at the time of writing.
